vars.content: a third ending, the drowned bell. At the crossing, a new once-only question, ask_bell, leads to a new node, bell_tale, where the stranger tells of the bell of Old Hensmouth still ringing under the water; asking sets a new flag, knows_bell, and from bell_tale the player rows on back to the crossing. At the far bank, a new choice, to_tower, offered only to a player who knows of the bell, leads to a new node, bell_tower, whose choice ring_bell ends the story at a new node, end_bell, the ending bell in data/endings.json with its title under the key ENDING_BELL; from bell_tower the player can also row back to the far bank. Every new line, choice and title needs its English text in i18n/strings.csv within the length limits of its kind, and the other two endings must stay as they are

vars.problem: the architecture runner fails with an error in story/backdrop.gd (per-frame-lookup)

vars.report: Continue is gone and the endings they had found are forgotten after the update. The previous version saved user://save.json as {"version": 1, "choices": [<the ids of the choices taken in the story in progress, in order>], "found": [<the ids of the endings found>]}, with no node, flags or settings

after Continue, the story has forgotten what they said before they quit: the stranger acts as if they had never won her trust, they cannot bring the boat in at the far bank, and a lie they told about the toll can no longer be confessed

vars.goal: a title menu as the main scene res://main.tscn (root Main) with Menu/NewButton, Menu/ContinueButton, Menu/SettingsButton and Menu/QuitButton, where New story adds the story scene res://story/story.tscn as a child of Main named Story; in the story scene, a history (HUD/HistoryButton shows a CanvasLayer named History whose Box/Scroll/Lines label lists the lines so far and the choices taken, and whose Box/CloseButton hides it) and pause (Escape or HUD/PauseButton shows the scene's PauseMenu, a CanvasLayer with ResumeButton and QuitButton, and pauses the tree; ResumeButton hides it and resumes); once-only choices ("once": true in data/choices.json, read into each choice's once, offered only until taken in this story) for the stranger's questions ask_name and ask_cargo; a data.json for the kit's data runner covering the story's tables; a story check, StoryCheck.problems(graph) in scripts/story_check.gd, listing what is wrong with a story (a choice into a missing node, a node or an ending no order of choices reaches, a flag never set or never read) and empty for the game's; and a save by a SaveStore class (scripts/save_store.gd: SaveStore.new(path), read() and write(data) of a dictionary whose story holds the story in progress as Story.to_dict() gives it, its node, flags and history, and whose endings lists the endings found) in user://save.json, written at every line shown, so that ContinueButton carries on from that line
